note: Counts are exact entries in each published feed. The API may report smaller normalized-unique domain counts after URL, www and duplicate normalization.

primary.definition: Entries published in list.json; this is not a liveness count.

primary_dns.definition: Entries published in dns/active_domains.json after DNS validation.

community_dns.definition: Entries published in community/live_blocklist.json after DNS validation.

primary_content.definition: Entries published in dns/content_active.json after HTTP content validation.

community_content.definition: Entries published in community/content_live.json after HTTP content validation.
